name: Complex sentence examples
description:
COMPLEX SENTENCE
⇒ I + D
⇒ Independent + Dependent
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

1. I know that he is honest.
2. She said that she was busy.
3. When the rain stopped, we went outside.
4. I met the boy who won the prize.
5. If you work hard, you will succeed.
6. Although he was tired, he completed the task.
7. Because she was ill, she stayed at home.
8. The man who lives next door is a doctor.
9. As the sun rose, the birds started singing.
10. I will help you if you need me.
11. The book which you gave me is interesting.
12. Since it was late, we returned home.
13. Whoever works honestly earns respect.
14. While I was studying, my brother was sleeping.
15. He failed because he was careless.
16. The girl whose bag was lost is crying.
17. Before you leave, switch off the lights.
18. Though he is rich, he lives simply.
19. I remember the day when we first met.
20. Unless you hurry, you will miss the bus.
